title: How Indri connects developers and agents
description: Agents draw and revise; developers review one drawing and leave feedback on objects or screenshot-style areas. Every edit saves a version. Earlier versions can be opened or restored without deleting history.

nodes.label: Codex / Claude / agent
nodes.description: Reads code with its existing tools. Creates and revises drawings through Indri's MCP tools.

nodes.label: Indri MCP tools
nodes.description: Creates and revises drawings, retrieves feedback and selected/nearby objects from the comment's original revision, and replies or resolves threads. get_diagram can open an older revision; list_diagram_versions lists history. Endpoint: /mcp.

nodes.label: SQLite workspace
nodes.description: Persists drawings, graph snapshots and comment threads. Stable element IDs preserve object comments. Area comments retain coordinates and captured objects from their original revision. Stale writes are rejected.

nodes.label: Focused diagram review
nodes.description: Shows only the agent's working drawing, its comments and history. Drag a screenshot-style rectangle or click an object/empty space to comment. Browser and server share layout coordinates. HTTP APIs load/save feedback; the version chooser opens earlier drawings.

nodes.label: Developer
nodes.description: Reviews the drawing, selects areas to comment, browses versions, and asks the agent to continue from feedback. Comments do not automatically wake an idle agent.

nodes.label: Version history
nodes.description: Every diagram update records a graph snapshot. Open an earlier version with its original area pins. Restore as new version copies an old graph into a new current revision, keeping all intervening versions and discussion threads.
